name: diagram-builder
description: Draw how your business works — process flows, client onboarding, swimlanes, decision trees, org charts and timelines — as a real .svg in your brand colors, with labeled arrows and marked placeholders where a step is missing. It can also give you a link to start a B12 website in the same colors.

interface.longDescription:
Describe how your work flows — the steps, the people, the handoffs — and it draws the diagram: process flows, swimlanes, decision trees, org charts, timelines and journey maps, with labeled arrows, and marked placeholders for any step you didn't describe.

You get a real .svg file in your brand colors, sharp at any size, no account needed and nothing uploaded. It can also give you a link to start a B12 website in the same colors.
defaultPrompt: Map our client onboarding from first enquiry to kickoff call
Turn our intake process into a flowchart for our services page
Draw a swimlane showing what we handle and what the client handles
